policy_requirement: Current NASDAQ account value/exposure must be known for TRUE FULL GO; unresolved account state caps final status but must not suppress a valid research candidate.
pass_rule: A sanctioned connected broker adapter must, in the same run, return parseable current account value/cash state and current equity positions/exposure. Empty positions are valid known exposure. Permission/auth/tool errors are never PASS.
persistence_rule: Never persist balances, positions, account identifiers, buying power, or other private account values to the public repository; persist status/provenance only.

evidence: Midas officially supports authenticated brokerage connection through TradingView Trading Panel.
TradingView broker integration exposes account metadata, balance/equity state and positions; these are the exact read categories needed by the provider-neutral ACCOUNT gate.
TradingView documents sub-2-second polling/update paths for balances, account manager and positions.
No sanctioned end-user TradingView/Midas connector or callable API is currently exposed to the canonical ChatGPT scheduler.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.blocker: Technical read surface is proven, but canonical scheduler callability, safe user-token handoff and a non-disruptive session model are not available.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.reopen_condition: A sanctioned Midas or TradingView end-user connector/API becomes scheduler-callable with a session-safe authorization model, then fresh same-run read-only account value/cash and equity positions/exposure both parse successfully.
MIDAS_VIA_TRADINGVIEW_OFFICIAL.session_constraint: Midas support states the same customer account cannot be simultaneously connected to TradingView and the Midas application. A future canonical adapter must use an explicitly supported independent/service-token model or equivalent session-safe mechanism; it must not hijack or terminate the user's interactive Midas session.

LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.legacy_fallback: App Key + App Secret + Legacy Access Token is compatibility-only and requires explicit XRAY_ALLOW_LEGACY_TRADE_CAPABLE_CREDENTIAL opt-in before any network call.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.security_model: OAuth account scope is preferred. Probe performs only GET /v1/asset/account and GET /v1/asset/stock after OAuth token acquisition, or the equivalent SDK read calls on explicitly opted-in legacy credentials. It never persists balances, positions, account identifiers, access/refresh tokens, or secrets.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.canonical_gate_rule: Only the production final-gate workflow may activate this adapter from secure runtime secrets and fresh same-run parseable account_balance + stock_positions. No persisted provider result can create PASS.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.blocker: No OAuth account-scope or legacy OpenAPI credentials are currently configured in GitHub Actions secrets.
evidence: Longbridge current documentation makes OAuth 2.0 the default for new integrations; legacy API-key mode is compatibility-only.
Longbridge Account Assets and Stock Positions docs show OAuthBuilder/Config.from_oauth with TradeContext.account_balance and stock_positions.
Agent Auth documentation exposes separately selectable market-data, account and trading permissions; account capability can be granted without a trading permission.
Production probe prefers OAuth Bearer/refresh credentials, uses only the two read endpoints for OAuth, and remains network-free when secret input is absent/incomplete.
Network-free selftests cover OAuth bearer, OAuth refresh, scope denial, missing credentials, legacy opt-in guard, private-value non-persistence and stale/same-run terminal behavior.
Official Longbridge OAuth SDK persists refreshed tokens after each successful refresh and preserves the old refresh token only when the server omits a new one.
XRAY production probe detects a changed refresh token and fails closed before account reads when no authorized secure persistence channel exists.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.reopen_condition: Configure a Longbridge OAuth credential carrying ACCOUNT permission in GitHub Actions secrets (preferred), or explicitly opt in a legacy compatibility token; then the final factory itself must obtain fresh same-run parseable account_balance + stock_positions.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.same_run_rule: ACCOUNT_PASS may be created only when the production final-gate run itself invokes the read-only probe and both account_balance and stock_positions parse successfully in that exact workflow run.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.persisted_pass_rule: A prior probe result or persisted PASS may never be reused to create current ACCOUNT_PASS.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.refresh_persistence_rule: If OAuth refresh returns a different refresh_token than the configured input, ACCOUNT_PASS is forbidden unless the new token can be persisted to an authorized secure secret store. The current GitHub runner is ephemeral and has no secret-write channel.
LONGBRIDGE_DIRECT_OPENAPI.oauth_durability: Bearer-only can satisfy a fresh same-run read while valid, but autonomous renewal requires refresh-state persistence. Static refresh-secret use is accepted only when the server omits a replacement refresh token or returns the same token.

LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.sanctioned_surface: Official Longbridge hosted MCP at https://mcp.longbridge.com
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.authorization: Agent Auth Code or standard OAuth 2.1; user pre-selects ACCOUNT permission. Trading permission is not required for XRAY.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.security_model: Static Bearer is supplied only through GitHub Actions secret. Probe lists tools then calls exactly account_balance and stock_positions. It never serializes token, balances, positions, account identifiers, buying power or other private values.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.canonical_gate_rule: Only a fresh same-run production workflow call with both read-only results parseable may create ACCOUNT_PASS. Missing/expired/scope-denied Bearer remains blocked.
evidence: Longbridge Agent Auth Code documentation lets the user pre-select market-data, account and trading scopes; the code can never grant more than selected.
After redemption, Longbridge instructs clients to use the returned Bearer token directly against https://mcp.longbridge.com.
The main hosted MCP supports US accounts and routes them to the US data center.
This avoids the Direct OpenAPI refresh-token persistence problem because the canonical workflow consumes a pre-authorized hosted-MCP Bearer rather than refreshing OAuth state itself.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.blocker: No least-privilege ACCOUNT-scoped hosted-MCP Bearer is currently configured in GitHub Actions secrets.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.reopen_condition: Configure LONGBRIDGE_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN from a Longbridge Agent/Auth grant with ACCOUNT permission, then require same-run account_balance + stock_positions success.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP.same_run_rule: Persisted prior PASS is never reusable.

LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.sanctioned_surface: Official Longbridge hosted MCP restricted /v2 endpoint
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.authorization: OAuth 2.1 / Agent Auth with account.read. Longbridge source defines /v2 scopes as watchlist + account.read + trade.read and explicitly excludes trade.write.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.security_model: The restricted /v2 server allowlist includes account_balance and stock_positions while submit_order, cancel_order, replace_order, fund order writes, DCA/grid writes and money-movement tools are excluded. XRAY additionally calls only the two required account reads and never persists raw account values or the bearer.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.canonical_gate_rule: Only fresh same-run parseable account_balance + stock_positions from the official /v2 endpoint may create ACCOUNT_PASS. Missing, expired or scope-denied token remains blocked.
evidence: Official longbridge/longbridge-mcp source defines production account.read scope id 6.
Official /v2 scope set is watchlist + account.read + trade.read and deliberately excludes trade.write.
Official /v2 allowlist tests reject every tool assigned to trade.write and hard-excluded execution/money-movement tools.
Official scope catalogue maps account_balance and stock_positions to account.read.
Longbridge Agent Auth lets the user preselect permissions; the one-time code is exchanged for access+refresh tokens and the server remains stateless.
XRAY encrypted vault keeps token plaintext out of the public repository and persists refresh rotation as authenticated ciphertext only.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.blocker: No account.read-scoped /v2 Bearer is currently configured in GitHub Actions secrets.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.reopen_condition: Configure a one-time account.read Agent Auth Code as LONGBRIDGE_AGENT_AUTH_CODE (no trade.write). The next Final Factory must bootstrap encrypted vault and obtain same-run parseable account_balance + stock_positions with /v2 write surface absent.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.same_run_rule: Persisted prior PASS is never reusable.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.write_surface_rule: Official upstream /v2 allowlist excludes every trade.write tool and hard-excludes execution/DCA/IPO-order/money-movement surfaces; XRAY additionally manifest-checks writes absent before account reads.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.bootstrap: Generate one Longbridge Agent Auth Code with account permission and no trading-write permission; store only as GitHub Actions secret LONGBRIDGE_AGENT_AUTH_CODE. Final Factory can redeem it once, derive an encryption key from the now-consumed high-entropy code, encrypt access+refresh state, and commit ciphertext only.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.autonomous_refresh: Supported: refresh token rotation is re-encrypted and committed before account reads, so an upstream read failure cannot strand the next run.
LONGBRIDGE_HOSTED_MCP_V2.current_blocker: One-time Longbridge account.read Agent Auth Code has not yet been configured as GitHub Actions secret LONGBRIDGE_AGENT_AUTH_CODE; encrypted vault therefore does not yet exist.
